ui_bugs.issue: Multi-pick stale-index bug: after the FIRST refinery pick rewrites the formula (changes length), subsequent picks still splice using the ORIGINAL slot.idx and corrupt the formula. Repro: type '2d6+attribute+skill+stat:15-defect', click Refinery, pick Item from attr (works → '2d6+{attr:Item}+skill+stat:15-defect' OK), then pick Artisan from skill — formula becomes '2d6+{attr:Item{skill:Artisan}ll+stat:15-defect' (skill token inserted INSIDE the attr token braces). Workaround: click Refinery a second time after each pick to re-parse. RCA: MacroBuilder.jsx L113-127 resolveRefineryPick removes the resolved slot but does NOT re-parse the now-mutated formula or shift remaining slots' .idx by the length delta of the inserted typed token. Fix: after each pick, call setRefinery(_parseUnresolved(newFormula)) instead of filtering. Spec test (single Item pick) was PASS; this bug only surfaces when chaining 2+ picks in one Refinery session.

action_items: INFO — All V6.25.11 P0 acceptance criteria PASS. Backend canonical p.135/p.142 data, Item half-cost rule, codex node_kind extension, Refinery first-pick flow all working. No blocking issues.

MEDIUM — MacroBuilder.jsx L113-127 resolveRefineryPick has a stale-index bug on chained multi-picks. Replace `setRefinery((r) => r.filter((x) => x.idx !== slot.idx))` with `setRefinery(_parseUnresolved(newFormula))` — i.e., re-parse after each pick using the just-mutated formula. Use a functional setState pattern: setFormula((f) => { const newF = ...; setRefinery(_parseUnresolved(newF)); return newF; }). Single-pick flow (the spec test) is unaffected.

MINOR — `(TN N)` suffix from resolveRefineryPick (line 119,123) is appended directly into the formula string. Currently only triggers when slot.tn is set (stat:N case). For example picking 'body' for `stat:15` would write `{stat:body} (TN 15)` into the formula — the parenthesised text would then be interpreted as a malformed grouping by the dice engine. Recommend storing the TN in a side-channel (label/comment), not the formula. Non-blocking — spec's single-pick test only used the attr slot, never realised this code path.
critical_code_review_comments: MacroBuilder.jsx grew to 633 lines — still under the 700-line guideline but trending up. Consider extracting Refinery panel + _parseUnresolved + _expandClientSide + helpers into a separate macroRefinery.js module in next refactor cycle.
_parseUnresolved (L597-631) correctly masks already-typed `{kind:name}` regions before scanning bare words — robust against the user pre-typing typed tokens.

Stale-index bug (see action item #2) is a textbook React pitfall: state derived from a string offset becomes invalid as soon as the underlying string mutates. The fix (re-parse after every mutation) is 1-line.

besm_data.py source.book='BESM 4E' for both p.135 weapon enhancements AND p.142 weapon limiters is correct per request — earlier 'BESM Extras' only applied to V6.25.10's Apocophea-specific subset. Consistent.
/api/characters/{id}/validate response now contains rich note strings citing the rulebook page (e.g. 'Item (half-cost): raw 4 → ceil(4/2) = 2 pts (p.135)') — excellent for audit transparency.

Codex node POST endpoint (world_creation.py L371) correctly enforces GM/admin gate before any DB write. 422 Unprocessable Entity returns BEFORE the gate check (Pydantic body validation), but a player with a VALID body still hits the 403, so security is intact.

rca of the issue: Single multi-pick UI bug found and root-caused: MacroBuilder.jsx L113-127 resolveRefineryPick uses `slot.idx` as a static char offset into `formula`, but does not recompute the queue after each rewrite. The typed-token replacement (e.g. 'attribute' → '{attr:Item}') changes the formula length, so any remaining queued slots have stale offsets. Reproduction: open MacroBuilder on Eli, formula='2d6+attribute+skill+stat:15-defect', click Refinery, pick Item (formula → '2d6+{attr:Item}+skill+stat:15-defect' OK), pick Artisan (formula → '2d6+{attr:Item{skill:Artisan}ll+stat:15-defect' BROKEN — skill token spliced inside attr braces). Mitigation: in resolveRefineryPick, after computing the new formula, call setRefinery(_parseUnresolved(newFormula)) to re-tokenize. 1-line fix. Spec's single-Item-pick acceptance test was unaffected and PASSED.
